revision_gate: Resolve selected original path and compare resolved path, device, inode, byte size, nanosecond modification and change times around source reads and during status/page requests. Completed disk snapshots remain readable with a stale notice; source changes during preview or preparation invalidate unsafe work. Existing panel status poll reports steady-state changes; no new watcher or server timer is retained.

checks.desktop: Plugin installed in independent daemon. Original two rows and 32 bytes shown; external overwrite plus append produced change notice while old two-row snapshot stayed visible; explicit Refresh showed updated and appended three rows and 42 bytes. Tested before #7 merge; merged panel and real-file suite then passed.
checks.source_unchanged_by_viewer: The fixture was externally edited in the guest; the viewer did not write it.
checks.ui_lock: Acquired atomically before plugin install/input, released after prior plugin restoration.

limitations: Combined active-query/source-change stress behavior belongs to #10. The merged #7 search controls, request ownership, result count and source/refresh tests passed together.

Revision identity uses filesystem metadata, not a full-file checksum. A filesystem or privileged writer that changes bytes while preserving path, device, inode, size, mtime and ctime could evade detection.
Steady-state notices appear on the existing 500 ms panel status poll; no filesystem watcher is retained.
Desktop smoke ran on #9 before the #7 merge; post-merge source and search boundaries were verified in the real-file and panel suite, not by a second desktop smoke.
Ubuntu verification does not establish macOS or Windows runtime behavior.
